subject: Combined concession appeal for AstralNet pilot (credits + extension + rate)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: one-time combined concession for AstralNet pilot

Hi Vivek / Ben —

Quick ask: AstralNet (Leah Park, Dir. of AI) wants to move forward with a 90-day pilot but is asking for a combined concession we don’t normally approve without exec sign-off. Summary below:

- Ask: 120k free credits (to be used over 90 days), automatic 30-day trial extension after pilot, and a 15% first-year list-rate reduction if they sign within 45 days of pilot completion.
- Rationale: AstralNet is a mid-market buyer in finance (high compliance bar). They’ve committed to a 12-month POC plan post pilot and estimated ARR of $210k. They’ve already completed a security review and asked for a tiny SLA uplift.
- Why we need sign-off: total concession sits outside SDR-level threshold (credits + rate reduction combined exceeds delegated authority). Finance flagged projected one-time revenue impact ~ $8.4k (credits at cost), plus potential margin impact on the first-year revenue if rate reduction converts.

I’ve attached the pilot MOP and a pricing grid. Key timing: Leah asked for a decision by EOD Thursday so they can schedule engineering kickoff next week.

Recommended approval: approve the credits + extension conditional on (1) signed Letter of Intent committing to 12-month paid contract within 45 days of pilot completion, and (2) agreed evaluation metrics (latency SLA, monthly usage floor). If approved, I’ll issue a one-time promo code and we’ll capture terms in HubSpot + PO.

Happy to jump on a quick 15m call to walk through.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: astralnet_pilot_mop.pdf, astralnet_pricing_grid.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time combined concession for AstralNet pilot

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I approve:
1) Is the 120k credit gross (tokens billed at us list) or does it reflect our marginal cost assumptions? Need to understand financial hit.
2) What is the expected conversion probability to the 12-month paid agreement at the proposed 15% discount? Any references to similar deals?
3) Who owns the escalation path if they ask for additional infra (private deployment) mid-pilot?

If you can get me a short ROI note (1 paragraph) and confirm the credit accounting, I can provide provisional approval contingent on LOI language.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | VP Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

--
(Please include the HubSpot deal link and the MOP snapshot in the reply)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time combined concession for AstralNet pilot

Vivek — thanks, short answers inline below + quick ROI paragraph.

1) Credits: 120k free credits is a gross customer-facing credit. On our side we model token cost at ~7% of list for this workload (embedding-heavy + short generation). Estimated one-time cost = $8,400 (120k * cost-per-credit assumption). Finance has reviewed and is okay with one-time absorption if we get LOI.
2) Conversion probability: Based on similar mid-market deals (LumenWorks, NovaE), conversion with a structured MOP and exec sponsorship is ~55–65%. For a conservative estimate we’re using 50% which yields expected first-year ARR contribution of ~$105k (50% * $210k).
3) Escalation: Neha (CS/Implementation lead) will own infra escalation. If private deployment is requested, we’ll require an enterprise contract addendum and separate capacity scoping; that would be passed to Solutions (Ben) for pricing.

ROI (1-paragraph): Approving the combined concession is expected to accelerate AstralNet’s time-to-value and remove a commercial blocker that’s delaying kickoff. With a 50% conservative conversion probability to the agreed 12-month plan, expected incremental ARR is ~$105k in year one versus a one-time platform cost of ~$8.4k — a 12.5x return on one-time credits before considering retention upside. The 15% first-year rate concession is contingent on timely signature and limits downstream margin impact.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-2028-0587
Attached: MOP and pricing grid (same files).

Asking for provisional approval for the combo, conditional on adding LOI language (45-day signature clause) and the evaluation metrics. If you approve, I’ll prepare the promo code and LOI template and loop in finance for billing flow.

-Marissa

Attachments: astralnet_pilot_mop.pdf, astralnet_pricing_grid.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time combined concession for AstralNet pilot

Marissa / team —

Appreciate the ROI and the risk mitigations. Provisional approval granted: authorize the 120k credits and 30-day extension plus the 15% first-year discount on the condition that:

- LOI is signed within 45 days of pilot completion with explicit language on the 12-month commitment and cancellation penalties (we’ll route through Legal).
- Promotion is one-time and non-transferable; credits expire at pilot end + 30 days.
- Finance signs off on the promo accounting and we log the concession in the deal record.

Marissa — please proceed. Copy me on the LOI + HubSpot update and confirm when promo code is issued.

-Vivek

Approved by: Vivek Kulkarni | VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Leah Park <leah@astralnet.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@astralnet.com>
Date: 2028-06-23T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Combined concession appeal for AstralNet pilot (credits + extension + rate)

Marissa / team —

Thanks — this is great news and we appreciate the flexibility. We’ll review the LOI language and get the signed copy back within the 45-day window as requested. Please send over the promo code and the LOI draft when available and we’ll target a July 2nd kickoff for engineering.

Quick note: we might ask for a short onboarding workshop during week 1; Tom will coordinate timing with your CS lead (Neha).

Best,
Leah Park
Director, Applied AI | AstralNet
leah@astralnet.com

(Attachment referenced: PO-template.docx — we’ll send once LOI is signed)
